simple.text: Silliq muskul ham aktin–miozin tortişuvi, Ca²⁺ va ATP bilan qisqaradi, lekin **troponin yöq**: Ca²⁺ **kalmodulin**ga boğlanib **miozin yengil zanjir kinazasi (MLCK)** ni faollaştiradi. Köprikçalar juda sekin aylanadi → uzoq, kuçli, kam energiyali (**“latç”**) qisqariş. Qözğatuvçilar: nervlar, gormonlar, çöziliş, mahalliy kimyoviy omillar.

items.text: Tolalar diametri 1–5 µm, uzunligi 20–500 µm (skelet tolasi 30 baravar yöğon, yuzlab marta uzun).

**Köp birlikli (multi-unit)**: alohida tolalar, har biri nerv uçi bilan, asosan nerv nazorati; misollar — közning siliar muskuli, rangdor parda muskuli, soç kötaruvçi (piloerektor) muskullar (simpatik).

**Unitar (sinsitial, visseral)**: yuzlab–minglab tola bir birlik bölib qisqaradi; köp nuqtada yopişgan va **tirqişli birikmalar (gap junctions)** bilan boğlangan; içak, öt yöllari, siydik yöllari, baçadon, köp qon tomirlar; asosan nervdan taşqari stimullar.
Aktin ipi **ziç tanaçalar**ga birikadi (Z disk vazifasi); ba’zilari membranada, qöşni hujayralar tanaçalari oqsil köpriklar bilan boğlanib kuçni uzatadi.
Aktin miozindan 5–10 baravar köp; miozin ipi aktindan 2 baravar yöğon.
**“Yon qutbli” köprikçalar** — ikki tomonda qarama-qarşi yönalişda → hujayra uzunligining **80% gaça** qisqara oladi (skeletda <30%).
Köprikçalar aylaniş çastotasi skeletnikining 1/10–1/300; boş ATPaza faolligi past; lekin biriktirilgan vaqt uluşi katta.
Bir xil kuçni uşlaş uçun energiya 1/10–1/300 (har siklda bitta ATP, davomiyligidan qat’iy nazar) — içak, qovuq, öt pufagi kabi a’zolarning doimiy tonusi uçun muhim.
Qisqariş qözğalişdan 50–100 ms keyin boşlanadi, ~0,5 s da töliq, keyin 1–2 s da pasayadi; jami 1–3 s (skeletdan ~30 baravar uzun); turli silliq muskullarda 0,2 dan 30 s gaça.
Maksimal kuç köpinça **4–6 kg/sm²** (skelet 3–4).
**Latç mexanizmi**: töliq qisqarişdan keyin qözğalişni ança kamaytirsa ham kuç saqlanadi; energiya 1/300 gaça; soatlab tonus.

**Stress-relaksatsiya**: qovuq tez çözilsa bosim keskin oşadi, lekin 15–60 s da deyarli dastlabki darajaga qaytadi; hajm kamaysa — **teskari stress-relaksatsiya**. Kovak a’zo hajm özgarsa ham bosimni saqlaydi.
Sitozol Ca²⁺ oşadi (membrana kanallaridan kiriş va/yoki SR dan).
Ca²⁺ + **kalmodulin** (troponinga öxşaş oqsil).
Ca²⁺-kalmodulin **MLCK** ni faollaştiradi.
Har miozin boşining **regulyator yengil zanjiri** fosforlanadi → boş aktin bilan takror aylana oladi → qisqariş. Fosforlanmasa — aylanmaydi.

**Ca²⁺ manbai**: SR kam rivojlangan; asosan ECF dan (>10⁻³ M ga qarşi içkarida <10⁻⁷ M). Diffuziya 200–300 ms — **latent davr** (skeletdan ~50 baravar uzun). Yirikroq hujayralarda membrana botiqlari **kaveolalar** SR nayçalariga tegadi (T-nayçaning ibtidoiy öxşaşi; Fig. 8-4).
Kuç **hujayradan taşqari Ca²⁺** ga kuçli boğliq: me’yorning 1/3–1/10 qismiga tuşsa qisqariş töxtaydi (skeletda deyarli ta’sir yöq).

**Böşaşiş**: sekin ATP-li Ca²⁺ nasosi (taşqariga yoki SR ga) → Ca²⁺ kalmoduldan ajraladi → **miozin fosfataza** yengil zanjirdan fosfatni oladi → aylaniş töxtaydi. Böşaşiş vaqti faol fosfataza miqdoriga boğliq.

**Latç ning ehtimoliy mexanizmi**: kinaza va fosfataza kuçli faol bölsa — tez aylaniş va tez qisqariş; faollik kamaysa boşlar aktinda uzoqroq qoladi → biriktirilgan boşlar soni (statik kuç) saqlanadi, ATP kam sarflanadi.

Skeletdagi kabi tuzilgan birikmalar yöq. Avtonom tolalar muskul qatlami ustida diffuz tarmoqlanadi — **diffuz birikmalar**: mediator matriksga, hujayradan bir neça nm – bir neça µm masofaga çiqariladi; köp qavatli muskulda köpinça faqat taşqi qavat innervatsiyalanadi.
Terminal aksonlarda **varikozlar** (Şvann qobiği uzilgan, pufakçalar bilan). Ba’zi köp birlikli muskullarda 20–30 nm masofadagi **kontakt birikmalar** — tezroq javob.

Mediatorlar: **ACh** va **noradrenalin** (heç qaçon bitta toladan ikkalasi emas). ACh ba’zi a’zolarda qözğatadi, ba’zilarida tormozlaydi; noradrenalin odatda teskari ta’sir. Javob **reseptor turi**ga boğliq (61-bob).
Tinçlik potensiali −50...−60 mV (skeletdan ~30 mV kam manfiy).

Unitar muskulda AP: (a) **çöqqi potensiallar** 10–50 ms (elektr, gormon, mediator, çöziliş yoki öz-özidan); (b) **platoli AP** — repolyarizatsiya bir neça yuz ms dan 1000 ms gaça keçikadi (siydik yöli, ma’lum holatlarda baçadon, ba’zi tomirlar; yurak muskuliga öxşaş).
**Ca²⁺ kanallari** asosiy: kuçlanişga boğliq Ca²⁺ kanallari köp, Na⁺ kanallari kam. Ca²⁺ kanallari sekin oçiladi va uzoq oçiq turadi (plato sababi); kirgan Ca²⁺ bevosita qisqarişni ham boşlaydi.

**Sekin tölqinlar**: ba’zi muskullar öz-özidan qözğaladi; tölqin AP emas, özi qisqartirmaydi (sabab noma’lum — Na⁺ nasosining tebranişi yoki kanal ötkazuvçanligining ritmik özgarişi taxmin qilinadi). Çöqqisi −60 dan ~−35 mV (bösağa) ga yetsa AP lar va ritmik qisqariş — **pacemaker tölqinlari** (63-bob).
**Çöziliş** visseral muskulda AP çaqiradi → haddan taşqari tölgan içak avtomatik qisqarib, peristaltik tölqin hosil qiladi.

**Köp birlikli muskulda AP siz depolyarizatsiya**: tolalar AP hosil qiliş uçun juda kiçik; mediator çaqirgan mahalliy **junksional potensial** elektrotonik tarqalib qisqarişga yetadi (unitar muskulda AP uçun 30–40 tola bir vaqtda depolyarizatsiyalanişi kerak).
Silliq muskul qisqarişining ~yarmi AP siz, bevosita qisqariş apparatiga ta’sir orqali.

**Mahalliy vazodilatatorlar** (arteriolalar, metaarteriolalar, prekapillyar sfinkterlar — innervatsiyasi kam): O₂ kamligi, CO₂ ortiqligi, H⁺ ortişi, adenozin, sut kislotasi, K⁺ ortişi, **azot oksidi**, harorat oşişi; bosim pasayib çöziliş kamayişi ham kengaytiradi (17-bob).
**Gormonlar**: noradrenalin, adrenalin, angiotenzin II, endotelin, vazopressin, oksitotsin, serotonin, gistamin — qözğatuvçi yoki tormozlovçi reseptorga qarab.

Mexanizmlar: Na⁺/Ca²⁺ kanallarini oçib depolyarizatsiya (AP bilan yoki siz); tormozlaş — Na⁺/Ca²⁺ kanallarini yopiş yoki K⁺ kanallarini oçiş → **giperpolyarizatsiya**; membrana potensialisiz — SR dan Ca²⁺ çiqariş; tormozlaşda **adenilatsiklaza/guanilatsiklaza** → **cAMP/cGMP** → fermentlar fosforlanişi özgaradi, Ca²⁺ nasoslari (SR ga va taşqariga) faollaşadi → sitozol Ca²⁺ kamayadi.
Bir modda turli joyda turliça: **noradrenalin içak silliq muskulini tormozlaydi, qon tomirlarini qisqartiradi**.

full.text: CONTRACTION OF SMOOTH MUSCLE

Smooth muscle is composed of small fibers that are usu ally 1 to 5 micrometers in diameter and only 20 to 500 micrometers in length. In contrast, skeletal muscle fibers are as much as 30 times greater in diameter and hundreds of times as long. Many of the same principles of contrac tion apply to smooth muscle as to skeletal muscle. Most important, essentially the same attractive forces between myosin and actin filaments cause contraction in smooth muscle as in skeletal muscle, but the internal physical arrangement of smooth muscle fibers is different.
TYPES OF SMOOTH MUSCLE

The smooth muscle of each organ is distinctive from that of most other organs in several ways: (1) physical dimensions; (2) organization into bundles or sheets; (3) response to different types of stimuli; (4) characteristics of innervation; and (5) function. Yet, for the sake of sim plicity, smooth muscle can generally be divided into two major types, which are shown in **Figure 8-1**, _multi-unit smooth muscle_ and _unitary_ (or _single-unit_) _smooth muscle._

Multi-unit smooth muscle is composed of discrete, separate, smooth muscle fibers. Each fiber operates independently of the others and often is innervated by a single nerve ending, as occurs for skele tal muscle fibers. Furthermore, the outer surfaces of these fibers, like those of skeletal muscle fibers, are covered by a thin layer of basement membrane–like substance, a mix ture of fine collagen and glycoprotein that helps insulate the separate fibers from one another.
full.lead: Multi-Unit Smooth Muscle.

full.text: Important characteristics of multi-unit smooth muscle fibers are that each fiber can contract indepen dently of the others, and their control is exerted mainly by nerve signals. In contrast, a major share of control of unitary smooth muscle is exerted by non-nervous stimuli. Some examples of multi-unit smooth muscle are the ciliary muscle of the eye, the iris muscle of the eye, and the piloerector muscles that cause erection of the hairs when stimulated by the sympathetic nervous system.

Unitary smooth muscle is also called _syncytial smooth muscle_ or _visceral smooth muscle_. The term _unitary_ does not mean single muscle fibers. In stead, it means a mass of hundreds to thousands of smooth muscle fibers that contract together as a single unit. The fibers usually are arranged in sheets or bundles, and their cell membranes are adherent to one another at multiple points so that force generated in one muscle fiber can be transmitted to the next. In addition, the cell membranes are joined by many _gap junctions_ through which ions can flow freely from one muscle cell to the next so that ac tion potentials, or ion flow without action potentials, can travel from one fiber to the next and cause the muscle fib ers to contract together. This type of smooth muscle is also known as _syncytial smooth muscle_ because of its syncyt ial interconnections among fibers. It is also called _visceral smooth muscle_ because it is found in the walls of most vis cera of the body, including the gastrointestinal tract, bile ducts, ureters, uterus, and many blood vessels.
full.lead: Unitary Smooth Muscle.

full.text: CONTRACTILE MECHANISM IN SMOOTH MUSCLE
Chemical Basis for Smooth Muscle Contraction

Smooth muscle contains both _actin_ and _myosin filaments,_ having chemical characteristics similar to those of the actin and myosin filaments in skeletal muscle. It does not contain the troponin complex that is required for the con trol of skeletal muscle contraction, and thus the mecha nism for controlling contraction is different. This topic is discussed in more detail later in this chapter.

Chemical studies have shown that actin and myo sin filaments derived from smooth muscle interact with each other in much the same way that they do in skeletal muscle. Furthermore, the contractile process is activated by calcium ions, and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) is degraded to adenosine diphosphate (ADP) to provide the energy for contraction.

There are, however, major differences between the physical organization of smooth muscle and that of skeletal muscle, as well as differences in excitationcontraction coupling, control of the contractile process by calcium ions, duration of contraction, and the amount of energy required for contraction.
Physical Basis for Smooth Muscle Contraction

Smooth muscle does not have the same striated arrange ment of actin and myosin filaments as is found in skeletal muscle. Instead, electron micrographic techniques sug gest the physical organization shown in **Figure 8-2**, which illustrates large numbers of actin filaments attached to _dense bodies._ Some of these bodies are attached to the cell membrane, and others are dispersed inside the cell. Some of the membrane-dense bodies of adjacent cells are bonded together by intercellular protein bridges. It is mainly through these bonds that the force of contraction is transmitted from one cell to the next.

Interspersed among the actin filaments in the muscle fiber are myosin filaments. These filaments have a diam eter more than twice that of the actin filaments. In elec tron micrographs, 5 to 10 times as many actin filaments as myosin filaments are usually found.

To the right in **Figure 8-2** is a postulated structure of an individual contractile unit in a smooth muscle cell, show ing large numbers of actin filaments radiating from two dense bodies; the ends of these filaments overlap a myosin filament located midway between the dense bodies. This contractile unit is similar to the contractile unit of skeletal muscle, but without the regularity of the skeletal muscle structure. In fact, the dense bodies of smooth muscle serve the same role as the Z disks in skeletal muscle.

Another difference is that most of the myosin filaments have “side polar” cross-bridges arranged so that the bridges on one side hinge in one direction, and those on the other side hinge in the opposite direction. This configuration allows the myosin to pull an actin filament in one direction on one side while simultaneously pulling another actin fila ment in the opposite direction on the other side. The value of this organization is that it allows smooth muscle cells to contract as much as 80% of their length instead of being limited to less than 30%, as occurs in skeletal muscle.
Comparison of Smooth Muscle Contraction and Skeletal Muscle Contraction

Although most skeletal muscles contract and relax rap idly, most smooth muscle contraction is prolonged tonic contraction, sometimes lasting hours or even days. Therefore, it is to be expected that both the physical and chemical characteristics of smooth muscle versus skeletal muscle contraction would differ. Some of the differences are noted in the following sections.

The rapid ity of cycling of the myosin cross-bridges in smooth mus cle—that is, their attachment to actin, then release from the actin, and reattachment for the next cycle—is much slower than in skeletal muscle. The frequency is as little as 1/10 to 1/300 that in skeletal muscle. Yet, the _fraction of time_ that the cross-bridges remain attached to the ac tin filaments, which is a major factor that determines the force of contraction, is believed to be greatly increased in smooth muscle. A possible reason for the slow cycling is that the cross-bridge heads have far less ATPase activ ity than in skeletal muscle; thus, degradation of the ATP that energizes the movements of the cross-bridge heads is greatly reduced, with corresponding slowing of the rate of cycling.
full.lead: Slow Cycling of the Myosin Cross-Bridges.

full.text: Only 1/10 to 1/300 as much energy is required to sustain the same tension of contraction in smooth muscle as in skeletal muscle. This, too, is believed to result from the slow attachment and detachment cy cling of the cross-bridges, and because only one molecule of ATP is required for each cycle, regardless of its dura tion.
full.lead: Low Energy Requirement to Sustain Smooth Muscle Contraction.

full.text: This low energy utilization by smooth muscle is impor tant to the overall energy economy of the body because organs such as the intestines, urinary bladder, gallbladder, and other viscera often maintain tonic muscle contraction almost indefinitely.

A typical smooth muscle tissue begins to contract 50 to 100 milliseconds after it is excited, reaches full contraction about 0.5 sec ond later, and then declines in contractile force in another 1 to 2 seconds, giving a total contraction time of 1 to 3 seconds. This is about 30 times as long as a single contrac tion of an average skeletal muscle fiber. However, because there are so many types of smooth muscle, contraction of some types can be as short as 0.2 second or as long as 30 seconds.
full.lead: Slowness of Onset of Contraction and Relaxation of the Total Smooth Muscle Tissue.

full.text: The slow onset of contraction of smooth muscle, as well as its prolonged contraction, is caused by the slow ness of attachment and detachment of the cross-bridges with the actin filaments. In addition, the initiation of con traction in response to calcium ions is much slower than in skeletal muscle, as will be discussed later.

Despite the relatively few myosin filaments in smooth muscle, and despite the slow cycling time of the cross-bridges, the maximum force of contraction of smooth muscle is often greater than that of skeletal muscle, as much as 4 to 6 kg/ cm2 cross-sectional area for smooth muscle in compari son with 3 to 4 kilograms for skeletal muscle. This great force of smooth muscle contraction results from the pro longed period of attachment of the myosin cross-bridges to the actin filaments.
full.lead: Maximum Force of Contraction Is Often Greater in Smooth Muscle Than in Skeletal Muscle.

full.text: Once smooth muscle has developed full contraction, the amount of continu ing excitation can usually be reduced to far less than the initial level, even though the muscle maintains its full force of contraction. Furthermore, the energy consumed to maintain contraction is often minuscule, sometimes as little as 1/300 of the energy required for comparable sustained skeletal muscle contraction. This mechanism is called the _latch mechanism_.
full.lead: Latch Mechanism Facilitates Prolonged Holding of Contractions of Smooth Muscle.

full.text: The importance of the latch mechanism is that it can maintain prolonged tonic contraction in smooth muscle for hours, with little use of energy. Little continued excit atory signal is required from nerve fibers or hormonal sources.

Another im portant characteristic of smooth muscle, especially the visceral unitary type of smooth muscle of many hollow organs, is its ability to return to nearly its original _force_ of contraction seconds or minutes after it has been elongated or shortened. For example, a sudden increase in fluid volume in the urinary bladder, thus stretching the smooth muscle in the bladder wall, causes an im mediate large increase in pressure in the bladder. How ever, during about the next 15 to 60 seconds, despite continued stretch of the bladder wall, the pressure re turns almost exactly back to the original level. Then, when the volume is increased by another step, the same effect occurs again.
full.lead: Stress-Relaxation of Smooth Muscle.

full.text: Conversely, when the volume is suddenly decreased, the pressure falls drastically at first but then rises in another few seconds or minutes to or near the original level. These phenomena are called _stress-relaxation_ and _reverse stress-relaxation._ Their importance is that except for short periods, they allow a hollow organ to main tain about the same amount of pressure inside its lumen despite sustained large changes in volume.
REGULATION OF CONTRACTION BY CALCIUM IONS

As is true for skeletal muscle, the initiating stimulus for most smooth muscle contraction is an increase in intra cellular calcium ions. This increase can be caused in dif ferent types of smooth muscle by nerve stimulation of the smooth muscle fiber, hormonal stimulation, stretch of the fiber, or even changes in the chemical environment of the fiber.

Smooth muscle does not contain troponin, the regu latory protein that is activated by calcium ions to cause skeletal muscle contraction. Instead, smooth muscle con traction is activated by an entirely different mechanism, as described in the next section.

In place of troponin, smooth muscle cells contain a large amount of another regulatory protein called _calmodulin_ (**Figure 8-3**). Although this protein is similar to troponin, it is different in the manner in which it initiates contraction. Calmodulin initiates contraction by activating the myosin cross-bridges. This activation and subsequent contraction occur in the following sequence: 1. The calcium concentration in the cytosolic fluid of the smooth muscle increases as a result of the influx of calcium from the extracellular fluid through cal cium channels and/or release of calcium from the sarcoplasmic reticulum. 2. The calcium ions bind reversibly with calmodulin. 3. The calmodulin-calcium complex then joins with and activates _myosin light chain kinase_, a phospho rylating enzyme. 4. One of the light chains of each myosin head, called the _regulatory chain_, becomes phosphorylated in response to this myosin kinase. When this chain is not phosphorylated, the attachment-detachment cycling of the myosin head with the actin filament does not occur. However, when the regulatory chain is phosphorylated, the head has the capability of binding repetitively with the actin filament and pro ceeding through the entire cycling process of inter mittent pulls, the same as what occurs for skeletal muscle, thus causing muscle contraction.
full.lead: Calcium Ions Combine with Calmodulin to Cause Activation of Myosin Kinase and Phosphorylation of the Myosin Head.

full.text: Source of Calcium Ions That Cause Contraction

Although the contractile process in smooth muscle, as in skeletal muscle, is activated by calcium ions, the source of the calcium ions differs. An important difference is that the sarcoplasmic reticulum, which provides virtu ally all the calcium ions for skeletal muscle contraction, is only slightly developed in most smooth muscle. Instead, most of the calcium ions that cause contraction enter the muscle cell from the extracellular fluid at the time of the action potential or other stimulus. That is, the concentra tion of calcium ions in the extracellular fluid is greater than 10−3 molar, in comparison with less than 10−7 molar inside the smooth muscle cell; this causes rapid diffusion of the calcium ions into the cell from the extracellular fluid when the calcium channels open. The time required for this diffusion to occur averages 200 to 300 millisec onds and is called the _latent period_ before contraction begins. This latent period is about 50 times as great for smooth muscle as for skeletal muscle contraction.

**Figure 8-4** shows a few slightly developed sarcoplasmic tubules that lie near the cell membrane in some larger smooth muscle cells. Small invaginations of the cell mem brane, called _caveolae,_ abut the surfaces of these tubules. The caveolae suggest a rudimentary analog of the trans verse tubule system of skeletal muscle. When an action potential is transmitted into the caveolae, this is believed to excite calcium ion release from the abutting sarcoplas mic tubules in the same way that action potentials in skel etal muscle transverse tubules cause release of calcium ions from the skeletal muscle longitudinal sarcoplasmic tubules. In general, the more extensive the sarcoplasmic reticulum in the smooth muscle fiber, the more rapidly it contracts.
full.lead: Role of the Smooth Muscle Sarcoplasmic Reticulum.

full.text: Whereas chang ing the extracellular fluid calcium ion concentration from normal has little effect on the force of contraction of skeletal muscle, this is not true for most smooth muscle. When the extracellular fluid calcium ion concentration decreases to about 1/3 to 1/10 normal, smooth muscle contraction usually ceases. Therefore, the force of con traction of smooth muscle is usually highly dependent on the extracellular fluid calcium ion concentration.
full.lead: Smooth Muscle Contraction Is Dependent on Extracellular Calcium Ion Concentration.

full.text: To cause relaxation of smooth muscle after it has contracted, the calcium ions must be removed from the intracellular fluids. This removal is achieved by a _cal cium pump_ that pumps calcium ions out of the smooth muscle fiber back into the extracellular fluid, or into a sarcoplasmic reticulum, if it is present (**Figure 8-5**). This pump requires ATP and is slow acting in comparison with the fast-acting sarcoplasmic reticulum pump in skeletal muscle. Therefore, a single smooth muscle contraction of ten lasts for seconds rather than hundredths to tenths of a second, as occurs for skeletal muscle.
full.lead: A Calcium Pump Is Required to Cause Smooth Muscle Relaxation.

full.text: Relaxation of the smooth muscle occurs when the calcium channels close and the calcium pump trans ports calcium ions out of the cytosolic fluid of the cell. When the calcium ion concentration falls below a critical level, the aforementioned processes automatically reverse, except for the phosphorylation of the myosin head. Re versal of this situation requires another enzyme, _myosin phosphatase_ (see **Figure 8-5**), located in the cytosol of the smooth muscle cell, which splits the phosphate from the regulatory light chain. Then the cycling stops, and contrac tion ceases. The time required for the relaxation of muscle contraction, therefore, is determined to a great extent by the amount of active myosin phosphatase in the cell.
full.lead: Myosin Phosphatase Is Important in Cessation of Contraction.

full.text: Because of the importance of the latch phe nomenon in smooth muscle, and because this phenom enon allows for the long-term maintenance of tone in many smooth muscle organs without much expenditure of energy, many attempts have been made to explain it. Among the many mechanisms that have been postulated, one of the simplest is the following.
full.lead: Possible Mechanism for Regulating the Latch Phenomenon.

full.text: When the myosin kinase and myosin phosphatase enzymes are both strongly activated, the cycling frequency of the myosin heads and the velocity of contraction are great. Then, as activation of the enzymes decreases, the cycling frequency decreases but, at the same time, the deactivation of these enzymes allows the myosin heads to remain attached to the actin filament for a longer and lon ger proportion of the cycling period. Therefore, the num ber of heads attached to the actin filament at any given time remains large. Because the number of heads attached to the actin determines the static force of contraction, ten sion is maintained, or latched, yet little energy is used by the muscle because ATP is not degraded to ADP, except on the rare occasion when a head detaches.
NERVOUS AND HORMONAL CONTROL OF SMOOTH MUSCLE CONTRACTION

Although skeletal muscle fibers are stimulated exclusively by the nervous system, smooth muscle can be stimulated to contract by nervous signals, hormonal stimulation, stretch of the muscle, and several other ways. The prin cipal reason for the difference is that the smooth muscle membrane contains many types of receptor proteins that can initiate the contractile process. Still other recep tor proteins inhibit smooth muscle contraction, which is another difference from skeletal muscle. Therefore, in this section, we discuss nervous control of smooth mus cle contraction, followed by hormonal control and other means of control.
NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTIONS OF SMOOTH MUSCLE

Neuromuscular junctions of the highly structured type found on skeletal muscle fibers do not oc cur in smooth muscle. Instead, the _autonomic nerve fibers_ that innervate smooth muscle generally branch diffusely on top of a sheet of muscle fibers, as shown in **Figure 8-6**. In most cases, these fibers do not make direct contact with the smooth muscle fiber cell membranes but instead form _diffuse junctions_ that secrete their transmitter substance into the matrix coating of the smooth muscle, often a few nanometers to a few micrometers away from the muscle cells. The transmitter substance then diffuses to the cells. Furthermore, where there are many layers of muscle cells, the nerve fibers often innervate only the outer layer. Mus cle excitation travels from this outer layer to the inner lay ers by action potential conduction in the muscle mass or by additional diffusion of the transmitter substance.
full.lead: Physiologic Anatomy of Smooth Muscle Neuromuscular Junctions.

full.text: The axons that innervate smooth muscle fibers do not have the typical branching end feet of the type found in the motor end plate on skeletal muscle fibers. Instead, most of the fine terminal axons have multiple _varicosi ties_ distributed along their axes. At these points, the _Schwann cells_ that envelop the axons are interrupted so that transmitter substance can be secreted through the walls of the varicosities. In the varicosities are vesicles similar to those in the skeletal muscle end plate that con tain transmitter substance. However, in contrast to the vesicles of skeletal muscle junctions, which always con tain acetylcholine, the vesicles of the autonomic nerve fiber endings contain acetylcholine in some fibers and norepinephrine in others and occasionally other sub stances as well.

In a few cases, particularly in the multi-unit type of smooth muscle, the varicosities are separated from the muscle cell membrane by as little as 20 to 30 nanome ters—the same width as the synaptic cleft that is found in the skeletal muscle junction. These are called _contact junctions_, and they function in much the same way as the skeletal muscle neuromuscular junction. The rapidity of contraction of these smooth muscle fibers is consid erably faster than that of fibers stimulated by the diffuse junctions.

The most important transmitter substances secret ed by the autonomic nerves innervating smooth muscle are _acetylcholine_ and _norepinephrine,_ but they are never secreted by the same nerve fibers. Acetylcholine is an ex citatory transmitter substance for smooth muscle fibers in some organs but an inhibitory transmitter for smooth muscle in other organs. When acetylcholine excites a muscle fiber, norepinephrine ordinarily inhibits it. Con versely, when acetylcholine inhibits a fiber, norepineph rine usually excites it.
full.lead: Excitatory and Inhibitory Transmitter Substances Secreted at the Smooth Muscle Neuromuscular Junction.

full.text: Why are these responses different? The answer is that both acetylcholine and norepinephrine excite or inhibit smooth muscle by first binding with a _receptor protein_ on the surface of the muscle cell membrane. Some of the receptor proteins are _excitatory receptors,_ whereas others are _inhibitory receptors._ Thus, the type of receptor deter mines whether the smooth muscle is inhibited or excited and also determines which of the two transmitters, ace tylcholine or norepinephrine, is effective in causing the excitation or inhibition. These receptors are discussed in more detail in Chapter 61 in regard to function of the autonomic nervous system.
MEMBRANE POTENTIALS AND ACTION POTENTIALS IN SMOOTH MUSCLE

The quanti tative voltage of the membrane potential of smooth mus cle depends on the momentary condition of the muscle. In the normal resting state, the intracellular potential is usually about −50 to −60 millivolts, which is about 30 mil livolts less negative than in skeletal muscle.
full.lead: Membrane Potentials in Smooth Muscle.

full.text: Action potentials occur in unitary smooth muscle (e.g., visceral muscle) in the same way that they occur in skeletal mus cle. They do not normally occur in most multi-unit types of smooth muscle, as discussed in a subsequent section.
full.lead: Action Potentials in Unitary Smooth Muscle.

full.text: The action potentials of visceral smooth muscle occur in one of two forms—(1) spike potentials or (2) action potentials with plateaus.

Typical spike action potentials, such as those seen in skeletal muscle, occur in most types of unitary smooth muscle. The duration of this type of ac tion potential is 10 to 50 milliseconds, as shown in **Fig ure 8-7A**. Such action potentials can be elicited in many ways—for example, by electrical stimulation, by the ac tion of hormones on the smooth muscle, by the action of transmitter substances from nerve fibers, by stretch, or as a result of spontaneous generation in the muscle fiber itself, as discussed subsequently.
full.lead: Spike Potentials.

full.text: **Figure 8-7C** shows a smooth muscle action potential with a plateau. The onset of this action potential is similar to that of the typical spike potential. However, instead of rapid repolarization of the muscle fiber membrane, the repolarization is delayed for several hundred to as much as 1000 milliseconds (1 sec ond). The importance of the plateau is that it can account for the prolonged contraction that occurs in some types of smooth muscle, such as the ureter, the uterus under some conditions, and certain types of vascular smooth muscle. Also, this is the type of action potential seen in cardiac muscle fibers that have a prolonged period of con traction, as discussed in Chapters 9 and 10.
full.lead: Action Potentials with Plateaus.

full.text: The smooth muscle cell membrane has far more voltage-gated calcium chan nels than skeletal muscle but few voltage-gated sodium channels. Therefore, sodium does not participate much in the generation of the action potential in most smooth muscle. Instead, the flow of calcium ions to the interior of the fiber is mainly responsible for the action potential. This flow occurs in the same self-regenerative way as oc curs for the sodium channels in nerve fibers and in skel etal muscle fibers. However, the calcium channels open many times more slowly than sodium channels, and they also remain open much longer. These characteristics largely account for the prolonged plateau action poten tials of some smooth muscle fibers.
full.lead: Calcium Channels Are Important in Generating the Smooth Muscle Action Potential.

full.text: Another important feature of calcium ion entry into the cells during the action potential is that the calcium ions act directly on the smooth muscle contractile mech anism to cause contraction. Thus, the calcium performs two tasks at once.

Some smooth muscle is self-excitatory—that is, ac tion potentials arise within the smooth muscle cells with out an extrinsic stimulus. This activity is often associated with a basic _slow wave rhythm_ of the membrane potential. A typical slow wave in a visceral smooth muscle of the gut is shown in **Figure 8-7B**. The slow wave is not the action potential. That is, it is not a self-regenerative process that spreads progressively over the membranes of the muscle fibers. Instead, it is a local property of the smooth muscle fibers that make up the muscle mass.
full.lead: Slow Wave Potentials in Unitary Smooth Muscle Can Lead to Spontaneous Generation of Action Potentials.

full.text: The cause of the slow wave rhythm is unknown. One suggestion is that the slow waves are caused by waxing and waning of the pumping of positive ions (presumably sodium ions) outward through the muscle fiber mem brane. That is, the membrane potential becomes more negative when sodium is pumped rapidly and less nega tive when the sodium pump becomes less active. Another suggestion is that the conductances of the ion channels increase and decrease rhythmically.

The importance of the slow waves is that when they are strong enough, they can initiate action potentials. The slow waves themselves cannot cause muscle contrac tion. However, when the peak of the negative slow wave potential inside the cell membrane rises in the positive direction, from −60 to about −35 millivolts (the approxi mate threshold for eliciting action potentials in most vis ceral smooth muscle), an action potential develops and spreads over the muscle mass and contraction occurs. **Figure 8-7B** demonstrates this effect, showing that at each peak of the slow wave, one or more action poten tials occur. These repetitive sequences of action potentials elicit rhythmical contraction of the smooth muscle mass. Therefore, the slow waves are called _pacemaker waves._ In Chapter 63, we see that this type of pacemaker activity controls the rhythmical contractions of the gut.

When visceral (unitary) smooth muscle is stretched sufficiently, spontaneous action potentials are usually generated. They result from a combination of the following: (1) the normal slow wave potentials; and (2) a decrease in overall negativity of the membrane potential caused by the stretch. This response to stretch allows the gut wall, when excessively stretched, to contract auto matically and rhythmically. For example, when the gut is overfilled by intestinal contents, local automatic contrac tions often set up peristaltic waves that move the contents away from the overfilled intestine, usually in the direction of the anus.
full.lead: Excitation of Visceral Smooth Muscle by Muscle Stretch.

full.text: DEPOLARIZATION OF MULTI-UNIT SMOOTH MUSCLE WITHOUT ACTION POTENTIALS

The smooth muscle fibers of multi-unit smooth muscle (e.g., the muscle of the iris of the eye or the piloerector muscle of each hair) normally contract mainly in response to nerve stimuli. The nerve endings secrete acetylcholine in the case of some multi-unit smooth muscles and norepi nephrine in the case of others. In both cases, the transmit ter substances cause depolarization of the smooth muscle membrane, and this depolarization in turn elicits contrac tion. Action potentials usually do not develop because the fibers are too small to generate an action potential. (When action potentials are elicited in _visceral unitary smooth muscle,_ 30 to 40 smooth muscle fibers must depolarize simultaneously before a self-propagating action potential ensues.) However, in small smooth muscle cells, even with out an action potential, the local depolarization (called the _junctional potential_) caused by the nerve transmitter sub stance spreads “electrotonically” over the entire fiber and is all that is necessary to cause muscle contraction.
Local Tissue Factors and Hormones Can Cause Smooth Muscle Contraction Without Action Potentials

Approximately half of all smooth muscle contraction is likely initiated by stimulatory factors acting directly on the smooth muscle contractile machinery and without action potentials. Two types of non-nervous and nonac tion potential stimulating factors often involved are (1) local tissue chemical factors and (2) various hormones.

In Chapter 17, we discuss control of contraction of the arterioles, meta-arterioles, and pre capillary sphincters. The smallest of these vessels have lit tle or no nervous supply. Yet, the smooth muscle is highly contractile, responding rapidly to changes in local chemi cal conditions in the surrounding interstitial fluid and to stretch caused by changes in blood pressure.
full.lead: Smooth Muscle Contraction in Response to Local Tissue Chemical Factors.

full.text: In the normal resting state, many of these small blood vessels remain contracted. However, when extra blood flow to the tissue is necessary, multiple factors can relax the vessel wall, thus allowing for increased flow. In this way, a powerful local feedback control system controls the blood flow to the local tissue area. Some of the specific control factors are as follows: 1. Lack of oxygen in the local tissues causes smooth muscle relaxation and, therefore, vasodilation. 2. Excess carbon dioxide causes vasodilation. 3. Increased hydrogen ion concentration causes vaso dilation. Adenosine, lactic acid, increased potassium ions, nitric oxide, and increased body temperature can all cause local vasodilation. Decreased blood pressure, by caus ing decreased stretch of the vascular smooth muscle, also causes these small blood vessels to dilate.

Many circulating hormones in the blood affect smooth muscle contraction to some degree, and some have pro found effects. Among the more important of these hor mones are _norepinephrine, epinephrine, angiotensin II, en dothelin, vasopressin, oxytocin, serotonin,_ and _histamine._
full.lead: Effects of Hormones on Smooth Muscle Contraction.

full.text: A hormone causes contraction of a smooth muscle when the muscle cell membrane contains _hormone-gated excitatory receptors_ for the respective hormone. Con versely, the hormone causes inhibition if the membrane contains _inhibitory receptors_ for the hormone rather than excitatory receptors.

Some hor mone receptors in the smooth muscle membrane open sodium or calcium ion channels and depolarize the mem brane, the same as after nerve stimulation. Sometimes, action potentials result, or action potentials that are al ready occurring may be enhanced. In other cases, depo larization occurs without action potentials, and this depo larization allows for calcium ion entry into the cell, which promotes the contraction.
full.lead: Mechanisms of Smooth Muscle Excitation or Inhibition by Hormones or Local Tissue Factors.

full.text: Inhibition, in contrast, occurs when the hormone (or other tissue factor) _closes the sodium and calcium chan nels_ to prevent entry of these positive ions; inhibition also occurs if the normally closed potassium channels are opened, allowing positive potassium ions to diffuse out of the cell. Both these actions increase the degree of negativ ity inside the muscle cell, a state called _hyperpolarization,_ which strongly inhibits muscle contraction.

Sometimes, smooth muscle contraction or inhibition is initiated by hormones without directly causing any change in the membrane potential. In these cases, the hormone may activate a membrane receptor that does not open any ion channels but, instead, causes an internal change in the muscle fiber, such as release of calcium ions from the intracellular sarcoplasmic reticulum; the calcium then induces contraction. To inhibit contraction, other recep tor mechanisms are known to activate the enzyme ade nylate cyclase or guanylate cyclase in the cell membrane. The portions of the receptors that protrude to the interior of the cells are coupled to these enzymes, causing the for mation of cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) or cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP), so-called sec ond messengers. cAMP or cGMP has many effects, one of which is to change the degree of phosphorylation of several enzymes that indirectly inhibit contraction. The pump that moves calcium ions from the sarcoplasm into the sarcoplasmic reticulum is activated, as well as the cell membrane pump that moves calcium ions out of the cell; these effects reduce the calcium ion concentration in the sarcoplasm, thereby inhibiting contraction.

Smooth muscles have considerable diversity in how they initiate contraction or relaxation in response to different hormones, neurotransmitters, and other sub stances. In some cases, the same substance may cause either relaxation or contraction of smooth muscles in different locations. For example, norepinephrine inhibits contraction of smooth muscle in the intestine but stimu lates contraction of smooth muscle in blood vessels.

figures.captionUz: Ca2+ hujayradan taşqariga yoki sarkoplazmatik retikulumga haydalib, kalsiy ionlari (Ca2+) konsentratsiyasi kritik darajadan pastga tuşganda silliq muskul böşaşadi. Şundan söng Ca2+ kalmoduldan (CaM) ajraladi, miozin fosfatazasi esa miozin yengil zanjiridan fosfatni olib taşlaydi; bu miozin boşçasining aktin filamentidan ajralişiga va silliq muskulning böşaşişiga sabab böladi. ADF — adenozindifosfat; ATF — adenozintrifosfat; Na+ — natriy; P — fosfat.

figures.originalCaption: Figure 8-6 Innervation of smooth muscle by autonomic nerve fib ers that branch diffusely and secrete neurotransmitter from multiple varicosities. Unitary (visceral) smooth muscle cells are connected by gap junctions so that depolarization can rapidly spread from one cell to another, permitting the muscle cells to contract as a single unit. In multi-unit smooth muscle, each cell is stimulated independently by a neurotransmitter released from closely associated autonomic nerve varicosities.
figures.captionUz: Silliq muskulning diffuz tarmoqlanuvçi va neyromediatorni köplab varikozlardan ajratuvçi vegetativ nerv tolalari bilan innervatsiyasi. Unitar (visseral) silliq muskul hujayralari tirqişli birikmalar orqali tutaşgan, şuning uçun depolyarizatsiya bir hujayradan ikkinçisiga tez tarqalib, muskul hujayralariga yagona birlik sifatida qisqariş imkonini beradi. Köp birlikli silliq muskulda har bir hujayra unga yaqin joylaşgan vegetativ nerv varikozlaridan ajralgan neyromediator tomonidan mustaqil qözğatiladi.

B, Içak devori silliq muskulida öz-özidan yuzaga keladigan sekin ritmik elektr tölqinlari çaqirgan takroriy çöqqisimon potensiallar. C, Baçadon silliq muskul tolasidan qayd qilingan platoli harakat potensiali.

ch08-f1.text: Silliq muskul odatda diametri 1–5 mikrometr va uzunligi atigi 20–500 mikrometr bölgan mayda tolalardan taşkil topgan. Skelet muskul tolalari esa, aksinça, diametri böyiça 30 martagaça katta va yuzlab marta uzun. Skelet muskulidagi qisqarişning köplab tamoyillari silliq muskul uçun ham amal qiladi. Eng muhimi, silliq muskulda ham skelet muskulidagi kabi miozin va aktin filamentlari örtasidagi aslida bir xil tortişiş kuçlari qisqarişni yuzaga keltiradi, ammo silliq muskul tolalarining içki fizik tuzilişi boşqaça.

ch08-f3.text: Har bir a’zoning silliq muskuli boşqa köpçilik a’zolarnikidan bir neça jihatdan farq qiladi: (1) fizik ölçamlari; (2) tutamlar yoki qatlamlar şaklida tuzilişi; (3) turli xil stimullarga javobi; (4) innervatsiya xususiyatlari; (5) funksiyasi. Şunga qaramay, soddalik uçun silliq muskulni umuman olganda **Rasm 8-1** da körsatilgan ikkita asosiy turga ajratiş mumkin: _köp birlikli silliq muskul_ va _unitar_ (yoki _bir birlikli_) _silliq muskul._

ch08-f5.text: Köp birlikli silliq muskul alohida, bir-biridan ajralgan silliq muskul tolalaridan taşkil topgan. Har bir tola boşqalaridan mustaqil işlaydi va köpinça skelet muskul tolalaridagi kabi bitta nerv uçi bilan innervatsiyalanadi. Bundan taşqari, bu tolalarning taşqi yuzalari, skelet muskul tolalarinikiga öxşab, bazal membranasimon moddaning yupqa qatlami bilan qoplangan; bu qatlam ingiçka kollagen va glikoproteindan iborat aralaşma bölib, alohida tolalarni bir-biridan ajratib (izolyatsiyalab) turişga yordam beradi.

ch08-f6.text: Köp birlikli silliq muskul tolalarining muhim xususiyatlari şundaki, har bir tola boşqalaridan mustaqil qisqara oladi va ular asosan nerv signallari orqali boşqariladi. Unitar silliq muskulning boşqaruvi esa, aksinça, katta qismi nervdan taşqari stimullar orqali amalga oşadi. Köp birlikli silliq muskulga misol sifatida közning kiprikli muskuli, köz rangdor pardasining muskuli va simpatik nerv tizimi tomonidan qözğatilganda tuklarning tikka turişiga sabab böladigan tuk kötaruvçi muskullarni keltiriş mumkin.

ch08-f7.text: Unitar silliq muskul _sinsitial silliq muskul_ yoki _visseral silliq muskul_ deb ham ataladi. _Unitar_ atamasi yakka muskul tolalarini anglatmaydi. Aksinça, u yagona birlik sifatida birgalikda qisqaradigan yuzlab-minglab silliq muskul tolalari massasini bildiradi. Tolalar odatda qatlamlar yoki tutamlar şaklida joylaşgan bölib, ularning hujayra membranalari köplab nuqtalarda bir-biriga yopişgan, şuning uçun bir muskul tolasida hosil bölgan kuç keyingisiga uzatilişi mumkin. Bundan taşqari, hujayra membranalari köplab _tirqişli birikmalar_ (gap junctions) orqali tutaşgan; ular orqali ionlar bir muskul hujayrasidan ikkinçisiga erkin oqib öta oladi, natijada harakat potensiallari yoki harakat potensialisiz ion oqimi bir toladan keyingisiga ötib, muskul tolalarining birgalikda qisqarişiga sabab böladi. Bu turdagi silliq muskul tolalar orasidagi sinsitial özaro boğlanişlari tufayli _sinsitial silliq muskul_ deb ham ataladi. U tanadagi köpçilik içki a’zolar (visseral a’zolar) — jumladan oşqozon-içak yöli, öt yöllari, siydik yöllari, baçadon va köplab qon tomirlari devorlarida uçragani uçun _visseral silliq muskul_ deb ham ataladi.

ch08-f10.text: Silliq muskulda kimyoviy xususiyatlari skelet muskulidagi aktin va miozin filamentlarinikiga öxşaş _aktin_ va _miozin filamentlari_ mavjud. Unda skelet muskuli qisqarişini boşqariş uçun zarur bölgan troponin kompleksi yöq, şuning uçun qisqarişni boşqariş mexanizmi boşqaça. Bu masala uşbu bobda keyinroq batafsilroq muhokama qilinadi.

ch08-f11.text: Kimyoviy tadqiqotlar silliq muskuldan olingan aktin va miozin filamentlari bir-biri bilan skelet muskulidagi kabi deyarli bir xil tarzda özaro ta’sirlaşişini körsatgan. Bundan taşqari, qisqariş jarayoni kalsiy ionlari tomonidan faollaştiriladi va qisqariş uçun energiya beriş maqsadida adenozintrifosfat (ATF) adenozindifosfatga (ADF) parçalanadi.

ch08-f12.text: Biroq silliq muskulning fizik tuzilişi bilan skelet muskulinikida, şuningdek qözğaliş-qisqariş boğlanişida, qisqariş jarayonining kalsiy ionlari tomonidan boşqarilişida, qisqariş davomiyligida va qisqariş uçun zarur bölgan energiya miqdorida jiddiy farqlar mavjud.

ch08-f14.text: Silliq muskulda aktin va miozin filamentlari skelet muskulidagi kabi köndalang-tarğil tartibda joylaşmagan. Buning örniga elektron mikroskopiya usullari **Rasm 8-2** da körsatilgan fizik tuzilişni taxmin qiladi: unda köplab aktin filamentlarining _ziç tanaçalarga_ birikkani tasvirlangan. Bu tanaçalarning ba’zilari hujayra membranasiga birikkan, boşqalari esa hujayra içida tarqalgan. Qöşni hujayralarning membranadagi ba’zi ziç tanaçalari hujayralararo oqsil köprikçalari orqali bir-biri bilan boğlangan. Qisqariş kuçi bir hujayradan keyingisiga asosan şu boğlar orqali uzatiladi.

ch08-f16.text: Muskul tolasida aktin filamentlari orasida miozin filamentlari joylaşgan. Bu filamentlarning diametri aktin filamentlarinikidan ikki baravardan köproq katta. Elektron mikrofotografiyalarda odatda aktin filamentlari miozin filamentlariga nisbatan 5–10 marta köp uçraydi.

ch08-f17.text: **Rasm 8-2** ning öng tomonida silliq muskul hujayrasidagi alohida qisqaruvçi birlikning taxminiy tuzilişi körsatilgan: ikkita ziç tanaçadan köplab aktin filamentlari nursimon tarqalgan; bu filamentlarning uçlari ziç tanaçalar örtasida joylaşgan miozin filamentini qoplaydi. Bu qisqaruvçi birlik skelet muskulining qisqaruvçi birligiga öxşaydi, ammo skelet muskuli tuzilişidagi muntazamlikka ega emas. Aslida silliq muskulning ziç tanaçalari skelet muskulidagi Z disklar bilan bir xil vazifani bajaradi.

ch08-f18.text: Yana bir farq şundaki, miozin filamentlarining köpçiligida “yon qutbli” köndalang köprikçalar böladi: ular şunday joylaşganki, bir tomondagi köprikçalar bir yönalişda, qarama-qarşi tomondagilari esa teskari yönalişda egiladi. Bunday tuziliş miozinga bir tomonda bitta aktin filamentini bir yönalişda tortib, bir vaqtning özida ikkinçi tomonda boşqa aktin filamentini qarama-qarşi yönalişda tortiş imkonini beradi. Bu tuzilişning ahamiyati şundaki, u silliq muskul hujayralariga skelet muskulidagi kabi uzunligining 30% idan kamroğiga çeklanib qolmasdan, uzunligining 80% igaça qisqariş imkonini beradi.

ch08-f19.text: Silliq muskul qisqarişi bilan skelet muskuli qisqarişining taqqoslanişi

ch08-f20.text: Köpçilik skelet muskullari tez qisqarib, tez böşaşsa-da, silliq muskul qisqarişining köp qismi uzoq davom etadigan tonik qisqariş bölib, ba’zan soatlab, hatto kunlab davom etadi. Şuning uçun silliq muskul va skelet muskuli qisqarişining fizik va kimyoviy xususiyatlari farq qilişini kutiş tabiiy. Bu farqlarning ba’zilari keyingi bölimlarda qayd etiladi.

ch08-f21.text: Silliq muskulda miozin köndalang köprikçalarining sikllaniş tezligi — ya’ni ularning aktinga birikişi, söngra aktindan ajralişi va keyingi sikl uçun qayta birikişi — skelet muskulidagiga qaraganda ança sekin. Uning çastotasi skelet muskulidagining atigi 1/10 dan 1/300 gaça qismini taşkil qiladi. Biroq köndalang köprikçalarning aktin filamentlariga birikkan holda qoladigan _vaqt uluşi_ — qisqariş kuçini belgilovçi asosiy omillardan biri — silliq muskulda ança ortgan, deb hisoblanadi. Sekin sikllanişning mumkin bölgan sababi şuki, köndalang köprikça boşçalarining ATFaza faolligi skelet muskulidagiga qaraganda ança past; şu sababli köndalang köprikça boşçalari harakatini energiya bilan ta’minlovçi ATFning parçalanişi ança kamaygan va sikllaniş tezligi ham mos ravişda sekinlaşgan.

ch08-f22.text: Silliq muskulda xuddi şunday qisqariş tarangligini saqlab turiş uçun skelet muskulidagiga nisbatan atigi 1/10 dan 1/300 gaça energiya talab etiladi. Bu ham köndalang köprikçalarning birikiş va ajraliş siklining sekinligi hamda har bir sikl uçun, uning davomiyligidan qat’i nazar, faqat bitta ATF molekulasi talab qilinişi bilan boğliq, deb hisoblanadi.
ch08-f22.lead: Silliq muskul qisqarişini saqlab turiş uçun energiya sarfining kamligi.

ch08-f23.text: Silliq muskulning energiyani bunday kam sarflaşi organizmning umumiy energiya tejamkorligi uçun muhim, çunki içaklar, siydik pufagi, öt pufagi va boşqa içki a’zolar köpinça tonik muskul qisqarişini deyarli çeksiz muddat saqlab turadi.

ch08-f24.text: Tipik silliq muskul töqimasi qözğatilgandan 50–100 millisekund ötgaç qisqara boşlaydi, taxminan 0,5 soniyadan keyin töliq qisqarişga yetadi, söngra yana 1–2 soniya içida qisqariş kuçi pasayadi; şunday qilib, umumiy qisqariş vaqti 1–3 soniyani taşkil qiladi. Bu örtaça skelet muskul tolasining yakka qisqarişidan taxminan 30 marta uzoqroq. Biroq silliq muskulning turlari juda köp bölgani uçun ba’zi turlarda qisqariş 0,2 soniyagaça qisqa yoki 30 soniyagaça uzoq bölişi mumkin.
ch08-f24.lead: Butun silliq muskul töqimasida qisqariş va böşaşişning sekin boşlanişi.

ch08-f25.text: Silliq muskul qisqarişining sekin boşlanişi, şuningdek uning uzoq davom etişi köndalang köprikçalarning aktin filamentlariga birikişi va ulardan ajralişining sekinligi bilan boğliq. Bundan taşqari, keyinroq muhokama qilinganidek, kalsiy ionlariga javoban qisqarişning boşlanişi skelet muskulidagiga qaraganda ança sekin keçadi.

ch08-f26.text: Silliq muskulda miozin filamentlari nisbatan kam bölişiga va köndalang köprikçalar sikllaniş vaqti sekin bölişiga qaramay, silliq muskul qisqarişining maksimal kuçi köpinça skelet muskulinikidan katta böladi: silliq muskul uçun köndalang kesim yuzasining har 1 sm2 iga 4–6 kg gaça, skelet muskuli uçun esa 3–4 kilogramm. Silliq muskul qisqarişining bunday katta kuçi miozin köndalang köprikçalarining aktin filamentlariga uzoq vaqt birikib turişi natijasidir.
ch08-f26.lead: Silliq muskulda qisqarişning maksimal kuçi köpinça skelet muskulidagidan katta.

ch08-f27.text: Silliq muskul töliq qisqarişga erişgandan söng, davom etayotgan qözğaliş miqdorini odatda boşlanğiç darajadan ança pastgaça kamaytiriş mumkin, lekin muskul baribir qisqarişning töliq kuçini saqlab turadi. Bundan taşqari, qisqarişni saqlab turiş uçun sarflanadigan energiya köpinça juda oz böladi — ba’zan skelet muskulining şunga öxşaş uzoq qisqarişi uçun zarur energiyaning atigi 1/300 qismiçalik. Bu mexanizm _qulflaş mexanizmi_ (latç mexanizmi) deb ataladi.
ch08-f27.lead: “Qulflaş” (latç) mexanizmi silliq muskul qisqarişlarini uzoq vaqt uşlab turişga imkon beradi.

ch08-f28.text: Qulflaş mexanizmining ahamiyati şundaki, u silliq muskulda uzoq davom etadigan tonik qisqarişni oz energiya sarflagan holda soatlab saqlab tura oladi. Nerv tolalari yoki gormonal manbalardan davomli qözğatuvçi signal juda kam talab etiladi.

ch08-f29.text: Silliq muskulning, ayniqsa köplab kovak a’zolardagi visseral unitar silliq muskulning yana bir muhim xususiyati — çözilgandan yoki qisqartirilgandan keyin bir neça soniya yoki daqiqa ötib qisqarişning dastlabki _kuçiga_ deyarli qaytiş qobiliyatidir. Masalan, siydik pufagidagi suyuqlik hajmining tösatdan ortişi pufak devoridagi silliq muskulni çözib, pufakdagi bosimni darhol keskin oşiradi. Biroq keyingi taxminan 15–60 soniya davomida, pufak devori çözilganiça qolişiga qaramay, bosim deyarli aynan dastlabki darajaga qaytadi. Söngra hajm yana bir poğona oşirilganda xuddi şu hodisa yana takrorlanadi.

ch08-f30.text: Aksinça, hajm tösatdan kamaytirilganda bosim avvaliga keskin tuşib ketadi, ammo keyingi bir neça soniya yoki daqiqa içida dastlabki darajagaça yoki unga yaqin darajagaça kötariladi. Bu hodisalar _stress-relaksatsiya_ va _teskari stress-relaksatsiya_ deb ataladi. Ularning ahamiyati şundaki, ular qisqa davrlarni hisobga olmaganda, kovak a’zoga hajmning uzoq davom etadigan katta özgarişlariga qaramay, böşliği içidagi bosimni taxminan bir xil darajada saqlab turiş imkonini beradi.

ch08-f32.text: Skelet muskulidagi kabi, silliq muskul qisqarişlarining köpçiligi uçun boşlovçi stimul hujayra içidagi kalsiy ionlari miqdorining ortişidir. Silliq muskulning turli turlarida bu ortiş silliq muskul tolasining nerv orqali qözğatilişi, gormonal stimulyatsiya, tolaning çözilişi yoki hatto tola atrofidagi kimyoviy muhitning özgarişi natijasida yuzaga kelişi mumkin.

ch08-f33.text: Silliq muskulda skelet muskuli qisqarişini yuzaga keltiriş uçun kalsiy ionlari tomonidan faollaştiriladigan boşqaruvçi oqsil — troponin yöq. Buning örniga, keyingi bölimda tasvirlanganidek, silliq muskul qisqarişi butunlay boşqa mexanizm orqali faollaştiriladi.

ch08-f34.text: Troponin örniga silliq muskul hujayralarida _kalmodulin_ deb ataladigan boşqa boşqaruvçi oqsil köp miqdorda böladi (**Rasm 8-3**). Bu oqsil troponinga öxşasa-da, qisqarişni boşlaş usuli bilan undan farq qiladi. Kalmodulin qisqarişni miozin köndalang köprikçalarini faollaştiriş orqali boşlaydi. Bu faollaşuv va undan keyingi qisqariş quyidagi ketma-ketlikda yuz beradi: 1. Kalsiyning hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdan kalsiy kanallari orqali kirişi va/yoki sarkoplazmatik retikulumdan ajralib çiqişi natijasida silliq muskulning sitozol suyuqligidagi kalsiy konsentratsiyasi ortadi. 2. Kalsiy ionlari kalmodulin bilan qaytar boğlanadi. 3. Söngra kalmodulin-kalsiy kompleksi fosforlovçi ferment — _miozin yengil zanjiri kinazasi_ bilan birikib, uni faollaştiradi. 4. Har bir miozin boşçasining _boşqaruvçi zanjir_ deb ataladigan yengil zanjirlaridan biri şu miozin kinazasi ta’sirida fosforlanadi. Bu zanjir fosforlanmagan bölsa, miozin boşçasining aktin filamentiga birikiş-ajraliş sikli yuz bermaydi. Biroq boşqaruvçi zanjir fosforlanganda boşça aktin filamenti bilan qayta-qayta boğlaniş va skelet muskulidagi kabi uzlukli tortişlarning butun sikl jarayonini bosib ötiş qobiliyatiga ega böladi va şu tariqa muskul qisqarişini yuzaga keltiradi.
ch08-f34.lead: Kalsiy ionlari kalmodulin bilan birikib, miozin kinazasining faollaşuviga va miozin boşçasining fosforlanişiga sabab böladi.

ch08-f36.text: Qisqarişni yuzaga keltiruvçi kalsiy ionlarining manbai

ch08-f37.text: Silliq muskulda ham, skelet muskulidagi kabi, qisqariş jarayoni kalsiy ionlari tomonidan faollaştirilsa-da, kalsiy ionlarining manbai farq qiladi. Muhim farqlardan biri şundaki, skelet muskuli qisqarişi uçun deyarli barça kalsiy ionlarini yetkazib beruvçi sarkoplazmatik retikulum köpçilik silliq muskullarda juda kam rivojlangan. Buning örniga qisqarişni yuzaga keltiruvçi kalsiy ionlarining köp qismi harakat potensiali yoki boşqa stimul paytida hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdan muskul hujayrasiga kiradi. Ya’ni hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdagi kalsiy ionlarining konsentratsiyasi 10−3 molyardan yuqori, silliq muskul hujayrasi içida esa 10−7 molyardan past; şu sababli kalsiy kanallari oçilganda kalsiy ionlari hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdan hujayra içiga tez diffuziyalanadi. Bu diffuziya uçun zarur bölgan vaqt örtaça 200–300 millisekundni taşkil qiladi va qisqariş boşlanişidan oldingi _latent davr_ deb ataladi. Silliq muskulda bu latent davr skelet muskuli qisqarişidagiga qaraganda taxminan 50 marta uzun.

ch08-f38.text: **Rasm 8-4** da ba’zi yirikroq silliq muskul hujayralarida hujayra membranasi yaqinida joylaşgan bir neçta kam rivojlangan sarkoplazmatik nayçalar körsatilgan. Bu nayçalarning yuzalariga _kaveolalar_ deb ataladigan hujayra membranasining kiçik botiqlari taqalib turadi. Kaveolalar skelet muskulidagi köndalang nayçalar tizimining rudimentar öxşaşi, deb taxmin qilinadi. Harakat potensiali kaveolalarga uzatilganda, xuddi skelet muskulining köndalang nayçalaridagi harakat potensiallari skelet muskulining böylama sarkoplazmatik nayçalaridan kalsiy ionlarini ajratib çiqargani kabi, u ham taqalib turgan sarkoplazmatik nayçalardan kalsiy ionlarining ajralişini qözğatadi, deb hisoblanadi. Umuman olganda, silliq muskul tolasida sarkoplazmatik retikulum qança keng rivojlangan bölsa, u şunça tez qisqaradi.

ch08-f40.text: Hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdagi kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasining normadan özgarişi skelet muskulining qisqariş kuçiga deyarli ta’sir qilmasa-da, köpçilik silliq muskullar uçun bu boşqaça. Hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdagi kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasi normaning taxminan 1/3 dan 1/10 gaça qismiga kamayganda silliq muskul qisqarişi odatda töxtaydi. Şuning uçun silliq muskulning qisqariş kuçi odatda hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdagi kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasiga kuçli boğliq.
ch08-f40.lead: Silliq muskul qisqarişi hujayradan taşqari kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasiga boğliq.

ch08-f41.text: Qisqargan silliq muskulni böşaştiriş uçun kalsiy ionlari hujayra içi suyuqliklaridan çiqarilişi kerak. Bunga kalsiy ionlarini silliq muskul tolasidan taşqariga — hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikka yoki, agar mavjud bölsa, sarkoplazmatik retikulumga qaytarib haydaydigan _kalsiy nasosi_ orqali erişiladi (**Rasm 8-5**). Bu nasos ATF talab qiladi va skelet muskulidagi tez işlaydigan sarkoplazmatik retikulum nasosiga qaraganda sekin işlaydi. Şuning uçun silliq muskulning yakka qisqarişi köpinça skelet muskulidagi kabi sekundning yuzdan yoki öndan bir qismlari emas, balki bir neça soniya davom etadi.
ch08-f41.lead: Silliq muskulning böşaşişi uçun kalsiy nasosi zarur.

ch08-f43.text: Silliq muskulning böşaşişi kalsiy kanallari yopilganda va kalsiy nasosi kalsiy ionlarini hujayraning sitozol suyuqligidan taşqariga taşiganda yuz beradi. Kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasi kritik darajadan pastga tuşganda, yuqorida qayd etilgan jarayonlar miozin boşçasining fosforlanişidan taşqari avtomatik ravişda teskari yönalişda keçadi. Bu holatni teskari tomonga qaytariş uçun silliq muskul hujayrasining sitozolida joylaşgan yana bir ferment — _miozin fosfatazasi_ (qarang: **Rasm 8-5**) kerak bölib, u boşqaruvçi yengil zanjirdan fosfatni ajratib oladi. Şundan söng sikllaniş töxtaydi va qisqariş tugaydi. Demak, muskul qisqarişining böşaşişi uçun zarur bölgan vaqt köp jihatdan hujayradagi faol miozin fosfatazasi miqdori bilan belgilanadi.
ch08-f43.lead: Miozin fosfatazasi qisqarişning töxtaşida muhim ahamiyatga ega.

ch08-f44.text: Qulflaş hodisasi silliq muskulda muhim ahamiyatga ega bölgani va u köplab silliq muskulli a’zolarda ortiqça energiya sarflamasdan tonusni uzoq muddat saqlab turiş imkonini bergani uçun uni tuşuntirişga köplab urinişlar qilingan. Taklif etilgan köplab mexanizmlar içida eng soddalaridan biri quyidagiça.
ch08-f44.lead: Qulflaş hodisasini boşqarişning mumkin bölgan mexanizmi.

ch08-f45.text: Miozin kinazasi va miozin fosfatazasi fermentlarining ikkalasi ham kuçli faollaşganda miozin boşçalarining sikllaniş çastotasi va qisqariş tezligi yuqori böladi. Söngra fermentlarning faollaşuvi pasaygan sari sikllaniş çastotasi kamayadi, ammo bir vaqtning özida bu fermentlarning nofaollaşuvi miozin boşçalariga sikl davrining tobora kattaroq qismida aktin filamentiga birikkan holda qoliş imkonini beradi. Şuning uçun istalgan vaqtda aktin filamentiga birikkan boşçalar soni köpligiça qoladi. Aktinga birikkan boşçalar soni qisqarişning statik kuçini belgilagani uçun taranglik saqlanib qoladi, ya’ni “qulflanadi”, biroq muskul juda kam energiya sarflaydi, çunki boşça ajralib çiqadigan kamdan-kam holatlarni hisobga olmaganda ATF ADFga parçalanmaydi.

ch08-f46.text: Silliq muskul qisqarişining nerv va gormonal boşqaruvi

ch08-f47.text: Skelet muskul tolalari faqat nerv tizimi tomonidan qözğatilsa-da, silliq muskulni nerv signallari, gormonal stimulyatsiya, muskulning çözilişi va boşqa bir qança yöllar bilan qisqarişga undaş mumkin. Bu farqning asosiy sababi şuki, silliq muskul membranasida qisqariş jarayonini boşlab bera oladigan köplab turdagi retseptor oqsillar mavjud. Yana boşqa retseptor oqsillar esa silliq muskul qisqarişini tormozlaydi — bu ham skelet muskulidan yana bir farqdir. Şu sababli uşbu bölimda avval silliq muskul qisqarişining nerv orqali boşqarilişini, söngra gormonal boşqaruv va boşqaruvning boşqa usullarini muhokama qilamiz.

ch08-f49.text: Silliq muskulda skelet muskul tolalaridagi kabi yuqori darajada tuzilgan nerv-muskul birikmalari uçramaydi. Buning örniga **Rasm 8-6** da körsatilganidek, silliq muskulni innervatsiyalaydigan _vegetativ nerv tolalari_ odatda muskul tolalari qatlami ustida diffuz tarmoqlanadi. Köp hollarda bu tolalar silliq muskul tolalarining hujayra membranalari bilan bevosita tutaşmaydi, balki öz mediator moddasini silliq muskulning matriks qoplamasiga — köpinça muskul hujayralaridan bir neça nanometrdan bir neça mikrometrgaça uzoqlikka ajratadigan _diffuz birikmalar_ hosil qiladi. Söngra mediator modda hujayralargaça diffuziyalanadi. Bundan taşqari, muskul hujayralarining qatlamlari köp bölgan joylarda nerv tolalari köpinça faqat taşqi qatlamni innervatsiyalaydi. Muskul qözğalişi bu taşqi qatlamdan içki qatlamlarga muskul massasida harakat potensialining ötkazilişi yoki mediator moddaning qöşimça diffuziyasi orqali tarqaladi.
ch08-f49.lead: Silliq muskul nerv-muskul birikmalarining fiziologik anatomiyasi.

ch08-f51.text: Silliq muskul tolalarini innervatsiyalaydigan aksonlarda skelet muskul tolalaridagi harakatlantiruvçi oxirgi plastinkada uçraydigan tipik tarmoqlangan oyoqçalar bölmaydi. Buning örniga ingiçka oxirgi aksonlarning köpçiligida ularning öqi böylab joylaşgan köplab _varikozlar_ (yöğonlaşmalar) böladi. Bu nuqtalarda aksonlarni örab turgan _Şvann hujayralari_ uzilgan böladi, şuning uçun mediator modda varikozlar devori orqali ajralib çiqa oladi. Varikozlarda skelet muskulining oxirgi plastinkasidagilarga öxşaş, mediator modda saqlovçi pufakçalar böladi. Biroq doim atsetilxolin saqlovçi skelet muskuli birikmalaridagi pufakçalardan farqli ölaroq, vegetativ nerv tolalari uçlaridagi pufakçalarda ba’zi tolalarda atsetilxolin, boşqalarida noradrenalin, ba’zan esa boşqa moddalar ham böladi.

ch08-f52.text: Ayrim hollarda, ayniqsa köp birlikli silliq muskulda, varikozlar muskul hujayrasi membranasidan atigi 20–30 nanometr masofada joylaşadi — bu skelet muskuli birikmasidagi sinaptik yoriq kengligi bilan bir xil. Bular _kontakt birikmalar_ deb ataladi va skelet muskulining nerv-muskul birikmasiga juda öxşaş tarzda işlaydi. Bunday silliq muskul tolalarining qisqariş tezligi diffuz birikmalar orqali qözğatiladigan tolalarnikiga qaraganda ança yuqori.

ch08-f53.text: Silliq muskulni innervatsiyalaydigan vegetativ nervlar ajratadigan eng muhim mediator moddalar — _atsetilxolin_ va _noradrenalin_, biroq ular heç qaçon bitta nerv tolasidan ajralmaydi. Atsetilxolin ba’zi a’zolarda silliq muskul tolalari uçun qözğatuvçi, boşqa a’zolarda esa silliq muskul uçun tormozlovçi mediatordir. Atsetilxolin muskul tolasini qözğatganda noradrenalin odatda uni tormozlaydi. Aksinça, atsetilxolin tolani tormozlaganda noradrenalin odatda uni qözğatadi.
ch08-f53.lead: Silliq muskul nerv-muskul birikmasida ajraladigan qözğatuvçi va tormozlovçi mediator moddalar.

ch08-f54.text: Nima uçun bu javoblar har xil? Gap şundaki, atsetilxolin ham, noradrenalin ham silliq muskulni avval muskul hujayrasi membranasi yuzasidagi _retseptor oqsil_ bilan boğlaniş orqali qözğatadi yoki tormozlaydi. Retseptor oqsillarning ba’zilari _qözğatuvçi retseptorlar_, boşqalari esa _tormozlovçi retseptorlar_ hisoblanadi. Şunday qilib, retseptor turi silliq muskul tormozlanişi yoki qözğalişini, şuningdek ikki mediatordan — atsetilxolin yoki noradrenalindan qaysi biri qözğaliş yoki tormozlanişni yuzaga keltirişda samarali ekanini belgilaydi. Bu retseptorlar 61-bobda vegetativ nerv tizimining funksiyasi bilan boğliq holda batafsilroq muhokama qilinadi.

ch08-f55.text: Silliq muskuldagi membrana potensiallari va harakat potensiallari

ch08-f56.text: Silliq muskul membrana potensialining miqdoriy kuçlanişi muskulning ayni paytdagi holatiga boğliq. Normal tinç holatda hujayra içidagi potensial odatda taxminan −50 dan −60 millivoltgaça böladi, bu skelet muskulidagiga qaraganda taxminan 30 millivoltga kamroq manfiy.

ch08-f57.text: Unitar silliq muskulda (masalan, visseral muskulda) harakat potensiallari skelet muskulidagi kabi yuzaga keladi. Keyingi bölimda muhokama qilinganidek, köp birlikli silliq muskul turlarining köpçiligida ular odatda yuzaga kelmaydi.

ch08-f58.text: Visseral silliq muskulning harakat potensiallari ikki şakldan birida namoyon böladi: (1) çöqqisimon (spayk) potensiallar yoki (2) platoli harakat potensiallari.

ch08-f59.text: Skelet muskulida kuzatiladigan kabi tipik çöqqisimon harakat potensiallari unitar silliq muskulning köpçilik turlarida uçraydi. **Rasm 8-7A** da körsatilganidek, bu turdagi harakat potensialining davomiyligi 10–50 millisekund. Bunday harakat potensiallarini köp yöllar bilan çaqiriş mumkin — masalan, elektr stimulyatsiyasi, gormonlarning silliq muskulga ta’siri, nerv tolalaridan ajraladigan mediator moddalar ta’siri, çöziliş yoki keyinroq muhokama qilinganidek, muskul tolasining özida öz-özidan hosil bölişi natijasida.

ch08-f60.text: **Rasm 8-7C** da platoli silliq muskul harakat potensiali körsatilgan. Bu harakat potensialining boşlanişi tipik çöqqisimon potensialnikiga öxşaydi. Biroq muskul tolasi membranasining tez repolyarizatsiyasi örniga repolyarizatsiya bir neça yuz millisekunddan 1000 millisekundgaça (1 soniyagaça) keçikadi. Platoning ahamiyati şundaki, u siydik yöli, ba’zi şaroitlarda baçadon va qon tomir silliq muskulining ayrim turlari kabi ba’zi silliq muskul turlarida kuzatiladigan uzoq davom etadigan qisqarişni tuşuntirib bera oladi. Şuningdek, 9- va 10-boblarda muhokama qilinganidek, qisqariş davri uzoq bölgan yurak muskul tolalarida ham aynan şu turdagi harakat potensiali kuzatiladi.

ch08-f62.text: Silliq muskul hujayrasi membranasida skelet muskulidagiga qaraganda potensialga boğliq kalsiy kanallari ança köp, potensialga boğliq natriy kanallari esa kam. Şuning uçun köpçilik silliq muskullarda natriy harakat potensialini hosil qilişda deyarli iştirok etmaydi. Buning örniga harakat potensialiga asosan kalsiy ionlarining tola içiga oqib kirişi sabab böladi. Bu oqim nerv tolalari va skelet muskul tolalaridagi natriy kanallari kabi öz-özini kuçaytiruvçi (regenerativ) tarzda keçadi. Biroq kalsiy kanallari natriy kanallariga qaraganda bir neça marta sekinroq oçiladi va ança uzoqroq oçiq holda qoladi. Ba’zi silliq muskul tolalaridagi uzoq platoli harakat potensiallari asosan aynan şu xususiyatlar bilan izohlanadi.
ch08-f62.lead: Kalsiy kanallari silliq muskul harakat potensialini hosil qilişda muhim ahamiyatga ega.

ch08-f63.text: Harakat potensiali paytida kalsiy ionlarining hujayralarga kirişining yana bir muhim xususiyati şundaki, kalsiy ionlari qisqarişni yuzaga keltiriş uçun silliq muskulning qisqariş mexanizmiga bevosita ta’sir qiladi. Şunday qilib, kalsiy bir vaqtning özida ikki vazifani bajaradi.

ch08-f64.text: Ba’zi silliq muskullar öz-özini qözğatuvçi böladi — ya’ni harakat potensiallari silliq muskul hujayralarida taşqi stimulsiz paydo böladi. Bu faollik köpinça membrana potensialining asosiy _sekin tölqin ritmi_ bilan boğliq. Içakning visseral silliq muskulidagi tipik sekin tölqin **Rasm 8-7B** da körsatilgan. Sekin tölqin harakat potensiali emas. Ya’ni u muskul tolalarining membranalari böylab asta-sekin tarqaladigan öz-özini kuçaytiruvçi jarayon emas. Aksinça, u muskul massasini taşkil etuvçi silliq muskul tolalarining mahalliy xususiyatidir.
ch08-f64.lead: Unitar silliq muskuldagi sekin tölqin potensiallari harakat potensiallarining öz-özidan hosil bölişiga olib kelişi mumkin.

ch08-f65.text: Sekin tölqin ritmining sababi noma’lum. Taxminlardan biriga köra, sekin tölqinlar musbat ionlarning (ehtimol, natriy ionlarining) muskul tolasi membranasi orqali taşqariga haydalişining kuçayişi va susayişi natijasida yuzaga keladi. Ya’ni natriy tez haydalganda membrana potensiali köproq manfiy, natriy nasosi sustroq işlaganda esa kamroq manfiy böladi. Boşqa bir taxminga köra, ion kanallarining ötkazuvçanligi ritmik ravişda ortib-kamayib turadi.

ch08-f66.text: Sekin tölqinlarning ahamiyati şundaki, ular yetarliça kuçli bölganda harakat potensiallarini boşlab bera oladi. Sekin tölqinlarning özi muskul qisqarişini yuzaga keltira olmaydi. Biroq hujayra membranasi içidagi manfiy sekin tölqin potensialining çöqqisi musbat yönalişda −60 dan taxminan −35 millivoltgaça (köpçilik visseral silliq muskulda harakat potensialini çaqirişning taxminiy bösağasi) kötarilganda harakat potensiali rivojlanadi, muskul massasi böylab tarqaladi va qisqariş yuz beradi. **Rasm 8-7B** da bu ta’sir körsatilgan: sekin tölqinning har bir çöqqisida bitta yoki bir neçta harakat potensiali yuzaga keladi. Harakat potensiallarining bu takroriy ketma-ketliklari silliq muskul massasining ritmik qisqarişini çaqiradi. Şuning uçun sekin tölqinlar _ritm yetakçisi (peysmeyker) tölqinlari_ deb ataladi. 63-bobda bu turdagi peysmeyker faolligi içakning ritmik qisqarişlarini boşqarişini köramiz.

ch08-f67.text: Visseral (unitar) silliq muskul yetarliça çözilganda odatda öz-özidan harakat potensiallari hosil böladi. Ular quyidagilarning birgalikdagi ta’siri natijasida yuzaga keladi: (1) normal sekin tölqin potensiallari; (2) çöziliş tufayli membrana potensiali umumiy manfiyligining kamayişi. Çözilişga bunday javob içak devoriga haddan taşqari çözilganda avtomatik va ritmik qisqariş imkonini beradi. Masalan, içak içidagi massa bilan haddan taşqari tölganda mahalliy avtomatik qisqarişlar köpinça peristaltik tölqinlarni yuzaga keltiradi; bu tölqinlar içak içidagi massani haddan taşqari tölgan içakdan, odatda orqa çiqaruv teşigi tomon uzoqlaştiradi.
ch08-f67.lead: Visseral silliq muskulning çöziliş orqali qözğalişi.

ch08-f68.text: Köp birlikli silliq muskulning harakat potensiallarisiz depolyarizatsiyasi

ch08-f69.text: Köp birlikli silliq muskulning (masalan, köz rangdor pardasi muskuli yoki har bir tukning tuk kötaruvçi muskuli) silliq muskul tolalari normal holatda asosan nerv stimullariga javoban qisqaradi. Ba’zi köp birlikli silliq muskullarda nerv uçlari atsetilxolin, boşqalarida esa noradrenalin ajratadi. Ikkala holatda ham mediator moddalar silliq muskul membranasining depolyarizatsiyasiga sabab böladi, bu depolyarizatsiya esa öz navbatida qisqarişni çaqiradi. Harakat potensiallari odatda rivojlanmaydi, çunki tolalar harakat potensialini hosil qiliş uçun juda kiçik. (_Visseral unitar silliq muskulda_ harakat potensiallari çaqirilganda öz-özidan tarqaluvçi harakat potensiali yuzaga kelişi uçun 30–40 ta silliq muskul tolasi bir vaqtda depolyarizatsiyalanişi kerak.) Biroq kiçik silliq muskul hujayralarida harakat potensiali bölmasa ham nerv mediator moddasi keltirib çiqargan mahalliy depolyarizatsiya (_birikma potensiali_ deb ataladi) butun tola böylab “elektrotonik” tarqaladi va muskul qisqarişini yuzaga keltiriş uçun şuning özi kifoya.

ch08-f70.text: Mahalliy töqima omillari va gormonlar silliq muskulning harakat potensiallarisiz qisqarişiga sabab bölişi mumkin

ch08-f71.text: Silliq muskul qisqarişlarining taxminan yarmi, ehtimol, silliq muskulning qisqariş mexanizmiga bevosita ta’sir qiluvçi va harakat potensiallarisiz işlovçi qözğatuvçi omillar tomonidan boşlanadi. Bunda köpinça iştirok etadigan nervga va harakat potensialiga boğliq bölmagan qözğatuvçi omillarning ikki turi — (1) mahalliy töqima kimyoviy omillari va (2) turli gormonlar.

ch08-f72.text: 17-bobda arteriolalar, metaarteriolalar va prekapillyar sfinkterlar qisqarişining boşqarilişini muhokama qilamiz. Bu tomirlarning eng kiçiklari nerv bilan juda kam ta’minlangan yoki umuman ta’minlanmagan. Şunga qaramay, ularning silliq muskuli yuqori darajada qisqaruvçan bölib, atrofdagi interstitsial suyuqlikdagi mahalliy kimyoviy şaroit özgarişlariga va qon bosimi özgarişi tufayli yuzaga keladigan çözilişga tez javob beradi.
ch08-f72.lead: Silliq muskulning mahalliy töqima kimyoviy omillariga javoban qisqarişi.

ch08-f73.text: Normal tinç holatda bu mayda qon tomirlarining köpçiligi qisqargan holatda böladi. Biroq töqimaga qöşimça qon oqimi zarur bölganda köplab omillar tomir devorini böşaştirib, qon oqimining ortişiga imkon beradi. Şu yöl bilan kuçli mahalliy teskari aloqa boşqaruv tizimi mahalliy töqima sohasidagi qon oqimini boşqaradi. Ba’zi aniq boşqaruv omillari quyidagilar: 1. Mahalliy töqimalarda kislorod yetişmasligi silliq muskulning böşaşişiga va demak, vazodilatatsiyaga sabab böladi. 2. Karbonat angidridning ortiqçaligi vazodilatatsiyaga sabab böladi. 3. Vodorod ionlari konsentratsiyasining ortişi vazodilatatsiyaga sabab böladi. Adenozin, sut kislotasi, kaliy ionlarining köpayişi, azot oksidi va tana haroratining kötarilişi — bularning barçasi mahalliy vazodilatatsiyaga sabab bölişi mumkin. Qon bosimining pasayişi ham qon tomir silliq muskulining çözilişini kamaytirib, bu mayda qon tomirlarining kengayişiga sabab böladi.

ch08-f74.text: Qonda aylanib yuruvçi köplab gormonlar silliq muskul qisqarişiga u yoki bu darajada ta’sir qiladi, ba’zilari esa kuçli ta’sir körsatadi. Bu gormonlarning muhimlari qatoriga _noradrenalin, adrenalin, angiotenzin II, endotelin, vazopressin, oksitotsin, serotonin_ va _gistamin_ kiradi.

ch08-f75.text: Agar muskul hujayrasi membranasida tegişli gormon uçun _gormon bilan boşqariladigan qözğatuvçi retseptorlar_ bölsa, gormon silliq muskulning qisqarişiga sabab böladi. Aksinça, agar membranada gormon uçun qözğatuvçi emas, balki _tormozlovçi retseptorlar_ bölsa, gormon tormozlanişga sabab böladi.

ch08-f76.text: Silliq muskul membranasidagi ba’zi gormon retseptorlari xuddi nerv stimulyatsiyasidan keyingi kabi natriy yoki kalsiy ion kanallarini oçadi va membranani depolyarizatsiyalaydi. Ba’zan natijada harakat potensiallari yuzaga keladi yoki allaqaçon yuzaga kelayotgan harakat potensiallari kuçayişi mumkin. Boşqa hollarda depolyarizatsiya harakat potensiallarisiz yuz beradi va bu depolyarizatsiya kalsiy ionlarining hujayraga kirişiga imkon berib, qisqarişga yordam beradi.
ch08-f76.lead: Silliq muskulning gormonlar yoki mahalliy töqima omillari tomonidan qözğatilişi yoki tormozlanişi mexanizmlari.

ch08-f77.text: Tormozlaniş esa, aksinça, gormon (yoki boşqa töqima omili) uşbu musbat ionlarning kirişiga yöl qöymaslik uçun _natriy va kalsiy kanallarini yopganda_ yuz beradi; normal holatda yopiq bölgan kaliy kanallari oçilib, musbat kaliy ionlarining hujayradan taşqariga diffuziyalanişiga imkon berganda ham tormozlaniş yuzaga keladi. Bu ikkala ta’sir ham muskul hujayrasi içidagi manfiylik darajasini oşiradi — bu holat _giperpolyarizatsiya_ deb ataladi va muskul qisqarişini kuçli tormozlaydi.

ch08-f78.text: Ba’zan silliq muskulning qisqarişi yoki tormozlanişi gormonlar tomonidan membrana potensialida bevosita heç qanday özgariş keltirib çiqarmagan holda boşlanadi. Bunday hollarda gormon heç qanday ion kanalini oçmaydigan, balki muskul tolasida içki özgarişni — masalan, hujayra içidagi sarkoplazmatik retikulumdan kalsiy ionlarining ajralib çiqişini yuzaga keltiradigan membrana retseptorini faollaştirişi mumkin; söngra kalsiy qisqarişni çaqiradi. Qisqarişni tormozlaş uçun boşqa retseptor mexanizmlari hujayra membranasidagi adenilatsiklaza yoki guanilatsiklaza fermentini faollaştirişi ma’lum. Retseptorlarning hujayra içiga çiqib turgan qismlari şu fermentlar bilan boğlangan bölib, siklik adenozinmonofosfat (sAMF) yoki siklik guanozinmonofosfat (sGMF) — ikkilamçi vositaçilar (messenjerlar) deb ataladigan moddalarning hosil bölişiga sabab böladi. sAMF yoki sGMF köplab ta’sirlarga ega; ulardan biri qisqarişni bilvosita tormozlaydigan bir qança fermentlarning fosforlaniş darajasini özgartirişdir. Kalsiy ionlarini sarkoplazmadan sarkoplazmatik retikulumga ötkazuvçi nasos, şuningdek kalsiy ionlarini hujayradan taşqariga çiqaruvçi hujayra membranasi nasosi faollaşadi; bu ta’sirlar sarkoplazmadagi kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasini kamaytiradi va şu tariqa qisqarişni tormozlaydi.

ch08-f79.text: Silliq muskullar turli gormonlar, neyromediatorlar va boşqa moddalarga javoban qisqariş yoki böşaşişni boşlaş usullari böyiça sezilarli darajada xilma-xil. Ba’zi hollarda bitta modda turli joylardagi silliq muskullarda yo böşaşiş, yo qisqarişga sabab bölişi mumkin. Masalan, noradrenalin içakdagi silliq muskul qisqarişini tormozlaydi, ammo qon tomirlaridagi silliq muskul qisqarişini kuçaytiradi.
